odi-examples.ifa

Odi: File I/O

File read, write, and existence checks for data persistence.

Use Case 1: Configuration File Manager

// config_manager.ifa - Save and load config

ayanmo CONFIG_FILE = "app.cfg";

ese load_config() {
    ti (Odi.wa(CONFIG_FILE)) {
        pada Odi.ka(CONFIG_FILE);
    }
    pada "theme=dark\nlang=en";
}

ese save_config(config) {
    Odi.ko(CONFIG_FILE, config);
    Irosu.fo("Configuration saved");
}

// Usage
ayanmo cfg = load_config();
Irosu.fo("Current config:");
Irosu.fo(cfg);
save_config("theme=light\nlang=en\nauto_save=true");

Use Case 2: Log File Reader

// log_reader.ifa - Read and count log lines

ese read_log(path) {
    ti (!Odi.wa(path)) {
        Irosu.kigbe("File not found: " + path);
        pada ofifo;
    }

    ayanmo content = Odi.ka(path);
    ayanmo count = 0;
    ayanmo i = 0;

    nigba (i < Ika.gigun(content)) {
        ti (Ika.ge(content, i, i + 1) == "\n") {
            ayanmo count = count + 1;
        }
        ayanmo i = i + 1;
    }

    Irosu.fo("File: " + path);
    Irosu.fo("Lines: " + count);
    Irosu.fo("Size: " + Ika.gigun(content) + " bytes");
    pada content;
}

// Usage
ayanmo data = read_log("server.log");
ti (data != ofifo) {
    Irosu.fo("First 60 chars: " + Ika.ge(data, 0, 60));
}

Use Case 3: File Backup with Timestamp

// backup.ifa - Backup files with timestamp suffix

ese backup_file(source) {
    ti (!Odi.wa(source)) {
        Irosu.kigbe("Source not found: " + source);
        pada iro;
    }

    ayanmo content = Odi.ka(source);
    ayanmo stamp = Iwori.akoko();
    ayanmo backup = source + "." + stamp + ".bak";

    Odi.ko(backup, content);
    Irosu.fo("Backup created: " + backup);
    pada otito;
}

// Usage
backup_file("data.db");
backup_file("config.yaml");
